run_launch_train: run the launch.py script with a YAML config file to train a model
create_config_train: create a YAML config file for the Trainer class with model and training parameters
build_trainer_instance: build a Trainer instance by passing a Hydra config dict as keyword arguments
test_launch_cli: test the launch.py CLI module with --config argument to verify config loading
review_trainer_run: review the Trainer.run() method that executes the training loop
